courses.text: Courses Community Login Find your path into Web3 Cohort-based programs from beginner fundamentals to specialised tracks. Fully online, free, and peer-led. BEGINNER · 20 WEEKS Coming Soon Blockchain Fundamentals Your first Web3 course Dates coming soon BEGINNER · 20 WEEKS Coming Soon Web3 Applications Your first Web3 course Dates coming soon BEGINNER · 20 WEEKS Coming Soon Blockchain and AI Your first Web3 course Dates coming soon Every course follows the same structure So you always know what’s next 1 Foundation AT THE START Lecture + Assignment Build your conceptual foundation through a lecture from expert speakers, then apply it with a hands-on assignment in one subtopic. PROGRESSIVE LEARNING CYCLE Research and teaching alternate, repeating until you've covered the whole topic. 2 Research IN SPECIALIST GROUPS Processing in Specialist Groups Meet peers in small specialist subgroups. Everyone researches the same subtopic from the lecture, becomes an expert on it, and prepares a presentation. 3 Teach PEER-TO-PEER, THEN A NEW LECTURE Group Teaching + New Lecture Specialist groups teach their subtopics to each other — you present your findings and learn theirs, piecing together the full picture through peer-to-peer teaching. Then a new lecture from an expert speaker adds fresh input — kicking off the next round of the cycle. The new lecture loops you back to Step 2 - a fresh subtopic each round. Free. Peer-led. community.text: Courses Community Login Get to know our Community Join Our Vibrant Web3 Community Web3Talents is a community where students learn, connect, and grow together. Members share ideas, support each other, and explore the world of Web3. Together with groups like the TUM Blockchain Club, we make blockchain learning fun and accessible. Built by students, driven by vision. Diversity is Key We believe that everyone has a place in Web3, and the best growth happens when we learn from our collective differences. Group Trips Explore the blockchain ecosystem beyond campus through exciting group trips and company visits. Hackathons Build, innovate, and collaborate with fellow students at our hands-on Web3 hackathons. Any Questions? Is the program free? Yes — every Web3 Talents course is completely free, supported by our partners and the TUM Blockchain Club. How can we apply to the courses? Applications open before each cohort. Head to the Courses page and hit Apply Now to register your interest. How time consuming is each course program? Expect a few hours a week across the 20-week cohort — a live session plus some group work and a short assignment. Can I still join the events even if I'm not a member? Absolutely — most community events are open to everyone. Just sign up and come along. Free. Peer-led. No experience needed. course.text: Courses Community Login All Courses > Blockchain Fundamentals Next cohort coming soon Beginner Online Blockchain Fundamentals Applications coming soon Build a strong foundation in blockchain, smart contracts, and Web3 through a structured 10-week learning experience. Apply now → See reviews → About Course What you’ll learn: Smart Contracts Bitcoin Transactions Decentralization & Trust Crypto Wallets Cryptography Basics Ethereum Architecture Course Description Curriculum FAQ This 10-week cohort takes you from the fundamentals of cryptography and consensus through to smart contracts and the wider Web3 economy. Each phase pairs an expert-led lecture with hands-on group work, so you learn by building — not just watching. Expand All Phase 1 Cryptography / Keys & Hashing Hashing, keys and digital signatures — the cryptographic primitives that make blockchains trustworthy. Phase 2 The Ledger Architecture How blocks, chains and consensus keep a distributed ledger consistent without a central authority. Phase 3 Securing the State Wallets, transactions and the security practices that protect on-chain state and user funds. Phase 4 The Programmable Layer Smart contracts and the programmable layer — how applications run logic directly on-chain. Phase 5 The New Economy & Future Outlook Tokens, DeFi and where the ecosystem is heading — from real-world assets to decentralised identity. Do I need prior experience? No — the course starts from first principles and is designed for complete beginners. How much time per week should I expect? Around 3–4 hours: one live session plus some group work and a short assignment. Is the course really free? Yes — every cohort is free, thanks to the TUM Blockchain Club and our partners.
